# web-retrieval-mcp

> Open-source Model Context Protocol server providing six read-only tools for
> source-separated Exa or Tavily web search, tiered page retrieval through Exa,
> guarded local Camoufox, optional Tavily Extract, and Firecrawl, plus AI/ML paper
> and developer-source indexes.

Use this index to understand, install, configure, evaluate, or integrate
`web-retrieval-mcp`. The README is the canonical user guide. The MCP tool schemas
exposed by the running server are authoritative for individual call parameters.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/README.md): Product overview, comparison with built-in agent web tools, quick start, client configuration, routing, security, and FAQ.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/web-retrieval-mcp/): Published Python distribution, version history, and install metadata.
- [MCP server manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/server.json): Official MCP Registry identity, package, transport, and environment-variable metadata.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp): Code, releases, issues, and contribution workflow.

## Technical documentation

- [Testing contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/docs/TESTING.md): Feature matrix, public-boundary acceptance tests, release gate, and remaining adaptation ledger.
- [Completed-result cache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/docs/CACHE.md): Valkey UDS setup, cache eligibility, privacy model, and singleflight behavior.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and the URL, redirect, DNS-rebinding, and HTTP trust boundaries.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/docs/README.md): Short map of project documentation.

## Distribution and maintenance

- [Release runbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/main/PUBLISHING.md): Versioning, artifact verification, public-history review, PyPI publication, MCP Registry publication, and discoverability checklist.
- [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=web-retrieval): Registry search for the published `io.github.VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp` server.
- [Releases](https://github.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/releases): Published versions and release notes.
- [Issues](https://github.com/VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp/issues): Bug reports, feature requests, and contribution discussion.

## Provider references

- [Exa](https://exa.ai): Default web search and indexed-content retrieval provider.
- [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev): Fallback web retrieval plus research-paper and developer indexes.
- [Tavily](https://www.tavily.com): Optional alternate search provider and full-body extraction tier.
- [Camoufox](https://github.com/daijro/camoufox): Optional local browser-rendering tier.
